profile.where: Rice cluster in Sichuan / Chongqing / Jiangxi

event.name: 2022 Yangtze basin drought + heatwave
event.summary: Replay of the 2022 Yangtze basin drought and heatwave during the mid-season rice window. Satellite and weather data are real; the farmer is fictional.

extensionOfficer.en: your local agricultural extension station (农技站)

clipPrompt.setting: rural southern China, terraced rice paddies
clipPrompt.farmer: a middle-aged rice farmer in a straw hat

scenes.irrigation_timing: early-morning sun over the paddies; the farmer opens a small earthen channel gate so a shallow layer of water flows in
scenes.prioritize_flowering_fields: close-up of rice panicles in flower, then the farmer guiding water to the flowering plot first
scenes.heat_stress_foliar_spray: late afternoon, the farmer walks the paddy with a backpack sprayer, fine mist over the leaves

irrigation_timing.en: If you still have water, open a small channel at dawn so a shallow layer covers the paddy. Confirm with your local agricultural station.
irrigation_timing.zh: 如果田里还有水，清晨把小沟打开，让一层浅水慢慢流进稻田，不要在最热的中午灌水。请先问当地农技站。

prioritize_flowering_fields.en: Give flowering rice the first water, then water the rest of the field if any remains. Confirm with your local agricultural station.
prioritize_flowering_fields.zh: 水不够的时候，先把水送到正在抽穗开花的田里，其他田块可以后浇，不要平均分。请先问当地农技站。

heat_stress_foliar_spray.en: Do not spray leaves in the midday heat. If a foliar spray is needed, wait until evening. Confirm with your local agricultural station.
heat_stress_foliar_spray.zh: 最热的中午不要喷叶面。如果需要叶面补充，放到傍晚再喷，并按农技站说的用量。请先问当地农技站。
